exercise.a_skip.technique.0: Rhythmic skip driving the knee up and striking under the hip with a quick toe-off.
exercise.a_skip.safety.0: Neuromuscular drill — not conditioning junk miles.
exercise.ab_wheel_rollout.technique.0: From knees, roll forward while keeping ribs down; pull back without lumbar sag.
exercise.ab_wheel_rollout.setup.0: Wheel under shoulders to start; modest ROM first.
exercise.ab_wheel_rollout.breathing: Exhale to return; do not dump into a breath-hold panic.
exercise.assisted_pull_up_band.technique: Anchor a band on the bar and kneel or step into it; perform a full-ROM pull-up while the band reduces net load.
exercise.assisted_pull_up_band.setup.0: Secure band carefully; stable footing when stepping in.
exercise.assisted_pull_up_band.common_mi: Bouncing out of the band stretch
exercise.assisted_pull_up_band.safety.0: Inspect bands for wear; set up so a snap cannot cause a fall onto equipment.
From hinged position, extend hips/trunk to a neutral finish without hyperextending; lower with control.
exercise.back_extension_roman.setup.0: Pad at hips; arms across chest.
exercise.back_extension_roman.safety.0: Think hip extension more than lumbar cranking.
exercise.back_squat.technique.0: Brace the trunk, set the bar on the upper back, and unlock hips and knees together.
exercise.back_squat.technique.1: Descend until thighs reach at least parallel while keeping heels down and knees tracking over mid-foot.
exercise.back_squat.technique.2: Drive up by extending hips and knees without losing lumbar neutrality.
exercise.back_squat.setup.0: Rack height at mid-chest; step under the bar; create upper-back shelf; walk out with short steps.
exercise.back_squat.breathing: Inhale and brace before descent; forceful exhale near lockout or use a brief Valsalva on heavy sets.
exercise.back_squat.safety.0: Use collars; clear spotters/safety pins; stop if sharp knee or spine pain.
exercise.back_squat.contraindications.1: Acute lumbar disc flare without clearance
exercise.back_squat.regressions.goblet_s: Learn depth and brace with goblet load
exercise.backstroke.technique.0: Float on back; alternate continuous arm circles with steady flutter kick; head neutral.
exercise.backstroke.setup.0: Know lane lines; careful at walls.
exercise.backstroke.breathing: Steady rhythmic breathing (face clear of water).
exercise.band_pull_apart.technique.0: Arms forward holding a band; pull apart until band touches chest; return slow.
exercise.barbell_bench_press.technique.0: Eyes under bar; set shoulder blades; gentle arch; feet planted.
exercise.barbell_bench_press.technique.1: Unrack, lower bar to lower chest/sternum with forearms vertical at bottom, press to lockout.
exercise.barbell_bench_press.setup.0: Spotter or safety arms; wrists stacked; consistent grip width.
exercise.barbell_bench_press.breathing: Inhale/brace on descent; exhale near lockout.
exercise.barbell_bench_press.safety.0: Never bench heavy without safeties/spotter; keep wrists neutral.
exercise.barbell_curl.technique.0: Elbows near sides; curl the bar without swinging; lower fully.
exercise.barbell_curl.setup.0: Standing tall; optional EZ bar for wrists.
exercise.barbell_row.technique.0: Hinge to torso ~30–45°, pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen, lower under control.
exercise.barbell_row.setup.0: Soft knees; braced spine; overhand or underhand grip.
exercise.barbell_row.common_mistakes.0: Using hip drive as a cheat if not intentional
exercise.barbell_row.safety.0: Keep the hinge solid; stop if back rounds.
exercise.bench_dip_assisted.technique.0: Hands on bench behind you, feet on floor; bend elbows to lower, then extend.
exercise.bench_dip_assisted.setup.0: Shoulders away from ears; modest ROM.
exercise.bench_dip_assisted.common_mista: Going too deep into shoulder extension
exercise.bench_dip_assisted.safety.0: Keep hips close to bench; shallow ROM if shoulders complain.
exercise.bird_dog.technique.0: Quadruped; extend opposite arm and leg without rotating hips; return and switch.
exercise.bird_dog.setup.0: Hands under shoulders; knees under hips.
exercise.box_squat.technique.0: Sit back to a box at parallel while keeping the trunk braced.
exercise.box_squat.technique.1: Touch lightly without fully relaxing the spine, then stand.
exercise.box_squat.setup.0: Set box height to target depth; same walkout as back squat.
exercise.box_squat.breathing: Brace before sitting; exhale to stand.
exercise.box_squat.safety.0: Use a stable box; spot heavy attempts.
exercise.breaststroke.technique.0: Pull-breathe-kick-glide timing; whip kick with knees tracking carefully; glide each cycle.
exercise.breaststroke.setup.0: Legal whip kick practice; neck comfortable.
exercise.breaststroke.breathing: Inhale during pull; exhale in glide/kick.
exercise.breaststroke.common_mistakes.1: Knee flare that stresses the joint
exercise.breaststroke.safety.0: Mind knee comfort on whip kick.
Medial knee pain with whip kick — modify
exercise.bridge_pose_yoga.technique.0: Supine; feet flat; lift hips; optional clasp hands; lower vertebra by vertebra.
exercise.bridge_pose_yoga.breathing: Inhale to lift or breathe steadily in the hold.
exercise.bridge_pose_yoga.safety.0: Same family as glute bridge with yoga pacing.
exercise.brisk_walk.technique.0: Walk with purposeful pace and arm swing; upright posture.
exercise.brisk_walk.safety.0: Excellent entry aerobic work and active recovery.
exercise.bulgarian_split_squat.technique: Rear foot elevated on a bench; descend on the front leg; stand without pushing mostly off the back foot.
exercise.bulgarian_split_squat.setup.0: Front foot far enough to keep heel down.
exercise.bulgarian_split_squat.common_mi: Front foot too close causing heel rise
exercise.bulgarian_split_squat.safety.0: Start unloaded; pad the rear foot.
exercise.bulgarian_split_squat.contraind: Rear-knee pain on the bench contact
exercise.butt_kicks.technique.0: Jog while kicking heels toward glutes with quick cadence; upright torso.
exercise.butterfly_stroke.technique.0: Simultaneous arm pulls with dolphin kick waves; breathe forward sparingly.
exercise.butterfly_stroke.setup.0: High energy cost — short repeats first.
exercise.butterfly_stroke.breathing: Exhale in water; quick inhale forward.
exercise.cable_chest_fly.technique.0: With a soft elbow, bring handles together in an arc; reverse slowly.
exercise.cable_chest_fly.setup.0: Cables at roughly chest height; stagger stance optional.
exercise.cable_woodchop.technique.0: Pull the handle across the body in a diagonal while rotating through the hips/torso with controlled arms.
exercise.cable_woodchop.safety.0: Rotate through thoracic/hips; keep knees soft.
exercise.calf_raise_standing.technique.0: Rise onto the forefoot through a full ankle ROM; lower to a stretch.
exercise.calf_raise_standing.setup.0: Straight knees for gastroc emphasis; soft knees shift soleus.
exercise.calf_raise_standing.safety.0: Control the eccentric for tendon health goals.
exercise.cat_cow.technique.0: Quadruped; alternate spinal flexion (cat) and extension (cow) with the breath.
exercise.cat_cow.setup.0: Hands under shoulders; knees under hips.
exercise.catch_up_drill.technique.0: Freestyle where one hand waits extended until the other hand catches up; promotes length and timing.
exercise.catch_up_drill.setup.0: Snorkel optional; focus on quiet entry.
exercise.catch_up_drill.breathing: Match freestyle breathing pattern or use snorkel.
Pausing so long that hips sink
exercise.chest_supported_row.technique.0: Chest on incline bench; row dumbbells without yanking; squeeze at the top.
exercise.chest_supported_row.common_mist: Lifting chest off pad to cheat
exercise.chest_supported_row.safety.0: Great when you want less lower-back fatigue.
Pull until the chest contacts the bar with control; lower fully.
exercise.chest_to_bar_pull_up.common_mis: Excessive kip if the goal is strength
exercise.chest_to_bar_pull_up.safety.0: Treat as a strength/skill hybrid; mind bar contact.
exercise.child_pose.technique.0: Kneel, sit toward heels, fold torso forward, arms long or by sides; breathe.
exercise.child_pose.setup.0: Knees together or wide; support with a blanket if needed.
exercise.child_pose.common_mistakes.0: Forcing hips to heels with knee pain
exercise.chin_up.technique.0: Use a supinated (underhand) grip about shoulder-width.
exercise.chin_up.setup.0: Underhand grip; braced trunk; avoid excessive lumbar swing.
exercise.chin_up.breathing: Exhale on the pull; inhale on the descent.
exercise.chin_up.common_mistakes.0: Turning it into a pure biceps curl with lost scapular control
exercise.chin_up.safety.0: Elbow tendinopathy — reduce volume or switch grips
exercise.close_grip_bench_press.techniqu: Grip nearer shoulder-width; lower with elbows closer to the torso; press.
exercise.close_grip_bench_press.safety.0: Avoid extreme narrow grip that stresses wrists.
exercise.conventional_deadlift.technique: Hip-hinge to the bar with shins close, spine neutral, lats engaged.
Push the floor away, keep the bar close, and lock hips and knees together at the top.
Return by hinging hips back first while keeping the bar over mid-foot.
exercise.conventional_deadlift.setup.0: Bar over mid-foot; grip just outside legs; brace before pull.
exercise.conventional_deadlift.breathing: Big brace before the pull; exhale at lockout or between reps.
exercise.conventional_deadlift.safety.0: Use mixed/hook grip carefully; stop if sharp back pain.
exercise.conventional_deadlift.regressio: Learn hinge with less load from floor
exercise.dead_bug.technique.0: Supine; opposite arm and leg extend while low back stays gently pressed toward floor; alternate.
exercise.dead_bug.setup.0: Knees over hips to start; exhale on extension.
exercise.dead_bug.breathing: Exhale as limbs extend; inhale to return.
exercise.dead_bug.common_mistakes.1: Moving both limbs on the same side unintentionally
exercise.dead_bug.safety.0: Reduce ROM to keep spine quiet.
exercise.deficit_deadlift.technique.0: Stand on a low plate/deficit; pull with the same cues as conventional, emphasising posture off the floor.
exercise.deficit_deadlift.setup.0: Small deficit (2–5 cm) first; perfect conventional form required.
exercise.deficit_deadlift.safety.0: Use only with solid conventional technique.
exercise.diamond_push_up.technique.0: Hands close under chest forming a diamond/triangle; perform push-up with elbows tracking nearer the torso.
exercise.diamond_push_up.safety.0: Wrist-friendly hand positions allowed if diamond stresses joints.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.technique.0: Support on parallel bars with locked elbows; lean slightly forward for chest emphasis or stay more upright for triceps.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.setup.0: Bars stable; shoulders packed down; avoid end-range extension if symptomatic.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.breathing: Inhale on the descent; exhale to press.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.common_mistake: Dumping into painful end-range shoulder extension
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.safety.0: Limit depth to avoid end-range glenohumeral extension when irritable (McKenzie et al. 2020).
exercise.downward_dog.technique.0: Press hips up and back into an inverted V; pedaling heels optional; long spine.
exercise.downward_dog.setup.0: Hands shoulder-width; feet hip-width; yoga mat.
exercise.downward_dog.safety.0: Bend knees if hamstrings are tight.
Acute wrist pain — use fists/forearms variants
Press dumbbells from chest level to lockout with wrists neutral; lower with control.
exercise.dumbbell_bench_press.setup.0: Kick or hoist dumbbells carefully into position.
exercise.dumbbell_bench_press.safety.0: Easier to match shoulder comfort than a bar for many.
exercise.dumbbell_curl.technique.0: Curl one or both dumbbells; optional supination through the ROM.
exercise.dumbbell_curl.safety.0: Unilateral work can fix side-to-side gaps.
exercise.dumbbell_incline_press.techniqu: Bench ~15–30°; press dumbbells up and slightly together; lower to outer chest.
exercise.dumbbell_incline_press.common_m: Too steep becoming a shoulder press
exercise.dumbbell_incline_press.safety.0: Keep incline modest for pectoralis emphasis.
exercise.easy_run.technique.0: Run at a conversational pace (roughly easy aerobic); relaxed shoulders; cadence comfortable.
exercise.easy_run.setup.0: Supportive shoes; safe route or treadmill.
exercise.easy_run.safety.0: Most weekly volume should feel easy in polarised models — descriptive, not dogma.
exercise.easy_run.contraindications.0: Chest pain / uncontrolled medical red flags — seek care
exercise.face_pull.technique.0: Pull rope toward face with elbows high; externally rotate slightly at the end; return slow.
exercise.face_pull.setup.0: Cable at upper-chest/face height; light load.
exercise.face_pull.common_mistakes.0: Turning it into a heavy row
exercise.face_pull.safety.0: Prioritise feel in rear delts/cuff over load.
exercise.farmers_carry.technique.0: Pick up heavy implements, stand tall, and walk with short controlled steps without leaning.
exercise.farmers_carry.setup.0: Clear path; loads equal unless suitcase variation.
exercise.farmers_carry.breathing: Steady breathing; avoid breath-holding the whole walk.
exercise.farmers_carry.safety.0: Drop safely if grip fails; use chalk/straps sparingly for grip goals.
Lie on floor; lower elbows to touch floor gently; press to lockout.
exercise.floor_press_dumbbell.common_mis: Bouncing elbows hard into the floor
exercise.freestyle_stroke.technique.0: Alternate arm pulls with body roll; flutter kick; face in water with rhythmic breathing to the side.
exercise.freestyle_stroke.breathing: Exhale underwater; inhale on the turn of the head.
exercise.freestyle_stroke.safety.0: Build volume gradually; stop with shoulder pain.
exercise.freestyle_stroke.contraindicati: Uncontrolled seizure disorders in water unsupervised
exercise.front_squat.technique.0: Hold the bar in a front-rack with elbows high; torso stays more upright than a back squat.
exercise.front_squat.technique.1: Sit between the hips to parallel or below while keeping elbows from dropping.
exercise.front_squat.technique.2: Stand by driving through mid-foot without elbows collapsing.
exercise.front_squat.setup.0: Clean the bar to front rack or take from rack; set stance roughly shoulder-width.
exercise.front_squat.breathing: Brace before descent; exhale as you stand.
exercise.front_squat.safety.0: Start light; wrist mobility alternatives (cross-arm) acceptable.
exercise.glute_bridge.technique.0: Lie supine, feet flat, drive hips up by squeezing glutes, pause, lower.
exercise.glute_bridge.safety.0: Keep ribs down; feel glutes more than low back.
Hold a goblet load; shift into one hip like a lateral lunge while the other leg stays long; alternate.
exercise.goblet_lateral_squat.common_mis: Twisting the foot of the straight leg
exercise.goblet_squat.technique.0: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest with elbows under the weight.
exercise.goblet_squat.technique.1: Sit hips down and back to a comfortable depth with chest tall.
exercise.goblet_squat.technique.2: Stand tall without shifting onto the toes.
exercise.goblet_squat.setup.0: Feet roughly shoulder-width; toes slightly out; weight held at sternum.
exercise.goblet_squat.safety.0: Choose a depth you can control; elevate heels slightly only if needed for mobility.
exercise.good_morning.technique.0: Bar on upper back; soft knees; hinge hips back until torso nears parallel; return by extending hips.
exercise.good_morning.setup.0: Light load; braced trunk; careful walkout.
exercise.good_morning.safety.0: Conservative loading; this stresses the posterior chain heavily.
History of lumbar stress injury — clinician clearance
exercise.hack_squat_machine.technique.0: Shoulders under pads; descend with knees tracking over toes; drive up without hips shooting back early.
exercise.hack_squat_machine.setup.0: Feet shoulder-width on platform; safeties engaged.
exercise.hack_squat_machine.safety.0: Control depth; avoid knee valgus crash.
exercise.hanging_knee_raise.technique.0: Hang; tilt pelvis slightly; raise knees toward chest; lower without swinging wildly.
exercise.hanging_knee_raise.safety.0: Use arm straps only if grip limits you and grip is not the goal.
exercise.high_knees_drill.technique.0: March/run in place or travel with exaggerated knee drive and quick ground contacts.
exercise.hip_abduction_machine.technique: Push the pads outward against resistance; return slow.
exercise.hip_adduction_machine.technique: Squeeze pads inward; control the return.
exercise.hip_adduction_machine.safety.0: Useful accessory; not mandatory for all.
exercise.hip_hinge_dowel.technique.0: Hold a dowel along head–thoracic–sacrum contact; push hips back keeping all three points; return tall.
exercise.hip_hinge_dowel.setup.0: Barefoot or flat shoes; soft knees.
exercise.hip_hinge_dowel.common_mistakes: Losing dowel contact at low back
exercise.hip_thrust.technique.0: Upper back on a bench, bar over hips with padding; drive hips to full extension with ribs down.
exercise.hip_thrust.technique.1: Lower with control without losing pelvic control.
exercise.hip_thrust.setup.0: Bench stable; shin vertical at lockout roughly; chin tucked slightly.
exercise.hip_thrust.safety.0: Pad the bar; avoid cervical strain from looking up hard.
exercise.incline_push_up.technique.0: Hands on a bench/rail; perform a rigid push-up.
exercise.incline_push_up.setup.0: Stable surface; body in straight line.
exercise.interval_run.technique.0: Alternate hard efforts with easy jog/walk recoveries for prescribed reps.
exercise.interval_run.safety.0: Quality over junk volume; stop with sharp pain.
exercise.inverted_row.technique.0: Hang under a bar or rings with the body straight, heels down; pull the chest to the bar; lower with control.
exercise.inverted_row.setup.0: Bar height sets difficulty; hollow/brace the trunk; neutral neck.
exercise.inverted_row.common_mistakes.1: Pulling only with the arms and poking the chin
exercise.inverted_row.safety.0: Primary regression for vertical pull-ups; keep a rigid plank line.
exercise.kettlebell_swing.technique.0: Hike the bell back high in the hips, then snap hips to standing; bell floats to about chest height.
exercise.kettlebell_swing.technique.1: Let the bell fall; hinge again; repeat rhythmically.
exercise.kettlebell_swing.setup.0: Feet shoulder-width; neutral spine; pack shoulders.
exercise.kettlebell_swing.breathing: Sharp exhale on the hip snap.
exercise.kettlebell_swing.safety.0: Clear space; use a flat sole shoe; stop if back rounds.
exercise.kickboard_kick.technique.0: Hold a kickboard; propel with flutter or dolphin kicks; keep kick from the hips.
exercise.knee_push_up.technique.0: From knees, keep a straight line from knees to head; lower and press.
exercise.landmine_press.technique.0: Press the angled bar forward-up from shoulder height; can be single-arm.
exercise.landmine_press.setup.0: Bar anchored in landmine; athletic stance.
exercise.landmine_press.safety.0: Useful when vertical pressing bothers the shoulder.
exercise.lat_pulldown.technique.0: Pull the bar to upper chest by driving elbows down; control the return to a soft stretch.
exercise.lat_pulldown.setup.0: Seat adjusted; thighs secured; torso tall.
exercise.lat_pulldown.safety.0: Prefer front pulldowns; avoid behind-neck variations.
exercise.lateral_lunge.technique.0: Step to the side, sit into that hip with the other leg straight, then push back to centre.
exercise.lateral_lunge.common_mistakes.0: The straight leg's toe turning out wildly
exercise.lateral_raise.technique.0: Raise dumbbells to roughly shoulder height with soft elbows; lower slowly; slight forward lead of pinkies optional.
exercise.lateral_raise.safety.0: Stop at shoulder height; control the eccentric.
exercise.leg_curl_machine.technique.0: Curl the pad by flexing the knees; control the return.
exercise.leg_curl_machine.setup.0: Adjust machine to fit limb length.
exercise.leg_extension_machine.technique: Extend the knees against the pad; lower under control.
exercise.leg_extension_machine.setup.0: Align knee joint with machine axis.
exercise.leg_extension_machine.safety.0: Useful accessory; not a full substitute for squats.
exercise.leg_extension_machine.contraind: Painful PF joint loading — reduce ROM/load
exercise.leg_press.technique.0: Place feet mid-platform; unlock knees slightly; lower until thighs approach torso without rounding lumbar spine.
exercise.leg_press.technique.1: Press through mid-foot to near lockout without slamming the sled.
exercise.leg_press.setup.0: Adjust seat so hips and knees stay comfortable; safety stops set.
exercise.leg_press.safety.0: Do not allow the lower back to peel off the pad.
exercise.leg_press.contraindications.0: Uncontrolled hypertension for heavy isometric straining
exercise.low_lunge.technique.0: Kneeling lunge with hands on front thigh or mat; ease hips forward for hip-flexor stretch.
exercise.low_lunge.safety.0: Posterior pelvic tilt gently to target hip flexors.
exercise.machine_chest_press.technique.0: Press handles to extension without slamming; return to a controlled stretch.
exercise.machine_chest_press.setup.0: Seat so handles align with mid-chest.
exercise.machine_chest_press.safety.0: Good learning tool before free weights.
exercise.machine_shoulder_press.techniqu: Press overhead on a machine path; lower with control.
exercise.machine_shoulder_press.setup.0: Seat height so handles start near shoulders.
exercise.mountain_pose.technique.0: Stand tall, feet together or hip-width, distribute weight evenly, arms by sides, long crown.
Kneel, ankles fixed; lower torso forward slowly using hamstrings; assist with hands/band to return.
exercise.nordic_curl_assisted.setup.0: Pad knees; partner or stable anchor for ankles.
exercise.nordic_curl_assisted.common_mis: Losing hip extension and folding at the hips
Hand and knee on bench; pull dumbbell to hip/pocket; lower with control.
exercise.one_arm_dumbbell_row.common_mis: Rotating the torso to yank the weight
exercise.overhead_press_barbell.techniqu: Bar at front rack; brace; press vertically while head moves through; lock out overhead; lower with control.
exercise.overhead_press_barbell.setup.0: Stance roughly hip-width; glutes tight; ribs down.
exercise.overhead_press_barbell.breathin: Brace before press; exhale through sticking point.
exercise.overhead_press_barbell.safety.0: Clear overhead mobility first; stop with shoulder pain.
exercise.overhead_press_dumbbell.techniq: Press dumbbells from shoulder height to lockout without shrugging excessively; lower slowly.
Seated version reduces cheat from legs.
exercise.paddle_freestyle.technique.0: Freestyle with hand paddles to increase pull resistance; shorten session volume.
exercise.paddle_freestyle.breathing: Do not breath-hold under higher load.
exercise.paddle_freestyle.safety.0: Paddles increase shoulder load — progress carefully.
exercise.pallof_press.technique.0: Stand side-on to a cable/band; press the handle straight out, resisting rotation; hold briefly; return.
exercise.pallof_press.common_mistakes.0: Letting the cable turn the hips
exercise.pause_back_squat.technique.0: Descend to depth, pause 1–3 s without losing brace, then stand without bouncing.
exercise.pause_back_squat.setup.0: Identical to back squat setup; use lighter load than touch-and-go.
exercise.pause_back_squat.breathing: Hold breath briefly during pause if braced; exhale near lockout.
exercise.pause_bench_press.technique.0: Lower to chest, pause 1 s without losing tension, press.
exercise.pause_deadlift.technique.0: Pull to just below the knee, pause while braced, then finish lockout.
exercise.pause_deadlift.safety.0: Positional tool — not for maximal testing.
exercise.pause_front_squat.technique.0: Front squat pattern with a controlled pause in the bottom.
exercise.pause_front_squat.setup.0: Front-rack setup; lighter than normal front squat.
exercise.pec_deck.technique.0: Bring arms together on the arc; return slowly without losing shoulder position.
exercise.pigeon_pose.technique.0: Front leg flexed in front with shin angled as comfortable; back leg extended; fold forward if appropriate.
exercise.pigeon_pose.setup.0: Use props under hip; never force the front knee.
exercise.pigeon_pose.safety.0: Figure-four on back is a safer alternative for many.
exercise.pigeon_pose.contraindications.0: Knee ligament issues — prefer supine figure-four
exercise.pilates_double_leg_stretch.tech: Knees in, arms to ankles; extend arms and legs away; circle arms to gather again.
exercise.pilates_double_leg_stretch.safe: Reduce extension ROM to keep back quiet.
exercise.pilates_hundred.technique.0: Curl head/shoulders up, legs in tabletop or extended, pump arms while breathing in 5 / out 5 for ~100 counts.
exercise.pilates_hundred.setup.0: Imprinted or neutral pelvis per school; neck supported if needed.
exercise.pilates_hundred.safety.0: Keep head down if neck fatigues; bend knees.
exercise.pilates_leg_circles.technique.0: Supine; one leg extended to ceiling; draw controlled circles without rocking the pelvis.
exercise.pilates_leg_circles.setup.0: Other leg long or bent; hands by sides.
exercise.pilates_leg_circles.safety.0: Shrink the circle to keep pelvis quiet.
exercise.pilates_plank_variations.techni: Hold a strong plank with Pilates breathing; optional small leg lifts if stable.
exercise.pilates_plank_variations.breath: Posterior lateral breathing cues common in Pilates.
exercise.pilates_roll_up.technique.0: From supine, articulate spine up to seated reach, then roll down with control.
exercise.pilates_roll_up.setup.0: Arms overhead to start; legs long or soft knees.
exercise.pilates_roll_up.breathing: Exhale to roll up; inhale at top; exhale to roll down.
exercise.pilates_roll_up.safety.0: Bend knees / use a strap if needed.
exercise.pilates_saw.technique.0: Seated wide legs; rotate and reach little finger toward opposite foot in a pulsing reach; switch.
exercise.pilates_saw.setup.0: Tall seat bones; soft knees OK.
exercise.pilates_shoulder_bridge.techniq: Articulate hips up into bridge; optional leg lifts; roll down.
exercise.pilates_shoulder_bridge.breathi: Inhale to prepare; exhale to articulate up.
Similar to glute bridge with articulation focus.
exercise.pilates_side_kick.technique.0: Lie on side; prop head; kick top leg forward/back with control while torso stays still.
exercise.pilates_side_kick.setup.0: Body in one long line; hand for support.
exercise.pilates_single_leg_stretch.tech: Head curled up; alternate pulling one knee in while extending the other leg.
exercise.pilates_single_leg_stretch.safe: Keep extended leg higher to make it easier.
exercise.pilates_swan.technique.0: Prone; lift chest using back extensors with legs long; lower with control.
exercise.pilates_swan.setup.0: Hands under shoulders; pubic bone heavy.
exercise.pilates_swan.breathing: Inhale to lift, exhale to lower (common).
exercise.plank.technique.0: Forearms and toes on floor; body straight; ribs down; squeeze glutes; hold.
exercise.plank.breathing: Steady breathing — do not hold breath the entire time.
exercise.plank.safety.0: Stop if lumbar pain; regress to knees or shorter holds.
exercise.plank.contraindications.0: Acute lumbar pain with extension bias
exercise.pull_buoy_pull.technique.0: Place pull buoy between thighs; swim freestyle emphasising the pull without kick.
exercise.pull_up.technique.0: Hang from a bar with a pronated (overhand) grip about shoulder-width or slightly wider.
exercise.pull_up.setup.0: Stable pull-up bar; wrists stacked; light brace; legs quiet or crossed.
exercise.pull_up.breathing: Exhale on the concentric pull; inhale on the descent.
exercise.pull_up.common_mistakes.0: Kipping when the goal is strict strength
exercise.pull_up.safety.0: Stop with anterior shoulder pain in the hang
exercise.push_press.technique.0: Dip with legs, drive up, and press the bar overhead as legs extend; lock out; lower.
exercise.push_press.safety.0: Coordinate legs and arms; use for overload carefully.
exercise.push_up.technique.0: High plank; lower chest toward floor with body rigid; press up without hips sagging.
exercise.push_up.safety.0: Elevate hands to regress; elevate feet to progress.
exercise.push_up.contraindications.0: Acute wrist pain — use handles/fists if appropriate
exercise.reverse_lunge_dumbbell.techniqu: Step backward into a lunge; front shin stays fairly vertical; return to stand.
exercise.reverse_lunge_dumbbell.safety.0: Often easier on the knees than forward lunges for some.
exercise.ring_dip.technique.0: Stabilise the rings in support, descend under control, press to support with rings turned out slightly at the top.
exercise.ring_dip.setup.0: Ring height appropriate; hollow body; master parallel-bar dips first.
exercise.ring_dip.safety.0: Rings increase stability demand; kinematic work suggests ring dips may use less peak shoulder extension than bar dips for some athletes — still respect pain-free depth (McKenzie et al. 2022).
exercise.romanian_deadlift_barbell.techn: From standing, push hips back with soft knees, slide the bar down the thighs until a strong hamstring stretch, then return.
exercise.romanian_deadlift_barbell.setup: Start from a rack or carefully lift off floor to stand; shoulder-blade set.
exercise.romanian_deadlift_barbell.breat: Inhale as you hinge, exhale as hips return.
exercise.romanian_deadlift_barbell.safet: Keep bar close; stop range before form breaks.
exercise.romanian_deadlift_dumbbell.tech: Hold dumbbells at thighs; hinge hips back; keep weights close to legs; stand by driving hips forward.
exercise.romanian_deadlift_dumbbell.safe: Use light loads to groove the pattern.
exercise.russian_twist.technique.0: Seated lean-back with feet on floor; rotate torso side to side with control.
exercise.russian_twist.setup.0: Keep chest up; optional light medicine ball later.
exercise.russian_twist.common_mistakes.0: Rounding and yanking the lumbar spine
exercise.russian_twist.safety.0: Feet down is fine; avoid if rotation aggravates symptoms.
exercise.seated_cable_row.technique.0: Sit tall; pull handle to torso; squeeze shoulder blades; return without rounding.
exercise.seated_cable_row.setup.0: Feet on platform; slight knee bend.
exercise.seated_cable_row.safety.0: Use a full stretch without lumbar flexion.
exercise.seated_forward_fold.technique.0: Sit tall; hinge from hips; reach toward feet; keep spine long; bend knees as needed.
exercise.seated_forward_fold.breathing: Exhale to fold gently; never bounce.
exercise.seated_forward_fold.safety.0: Bent knees are a valid pose.
exercise.seated_forward_fold.contraindic: Acute disc herniation symptoms — clinical advice
exercise.shrug_dumbbell.technique.0: Stand tall; elevate shoulders toward ears; lower slow; minimal elbow bend.
exercise.side_plank.technique.0: On one forearm/side of foot, lift hips to a straight line; hold; switch.
exercise.side_plank.setup.0: Elbow under shoulder; stacked feet or staggered.
exercise.side_plank.contraindications.0: Shoulder pain on the support side
exercise.single_leg_hip_thrust.technique: Same as hip thrust with one foot on the floor; keep hips level.
exercise.single_leg_rdl.technique.0: Hinge on the stance leg while the free leg reaches back; keep hips square; return to tall stand.
exercise.single_leg_rdl.setup.0: Light load; optional support for balance.
exercise.sit_to_stand.technique.0: From a chair, lean slightly forward, stand without using hands if possible, then sit with control.
exercise.sit_to_stand.setup.0: Stable chair against a wall; feet under knees.
exercise.sit_to_stand.safety.0: Use hands on thighs if needed; progress by removing assistance.
Severe orthostatic symptoms — seek clinical advice
exercise.smith_machine_squat.technique.0: Bar on a fixed path; squat with feet placed so knees track well; use safeties.
exercise.smith_machine_squat.setup.0: Feet slightly forward of a free squat for many users.
exercise.smith_machine_squat.common_mist: Feet too far under bar causing awkward path
exercise.smith_machine_squat.safety.0: Fixed path ≠ free squat transfer; still useful.
exercise.split_squat_bodyweight.techniqu: Static split stance; lower vertically; rise.
exercise.split_squat_bodyweight.setup.0: Short or long stance alters emphasis; keep pelvis level.
exercise.split_squat_bodyweight.safety.0: Hold a support for balance if needed.
exercise.step_up.technique.0: Step onto a box with the whole foot; stand tall; step down with control.
exercise.step_up.setup.0: Box height where knee comfort allows; no push-off cheating from the trail leg.
exercise.step_up.common_mistakes.0: Pushing mostly with the bottom leg
exercise.step_up.safety.0: Start low; hold rail if needed.
exercise.suitcase_carry.technique.0: Carry a load in one hand while keeping shoulders and hips level; switch sides.
exercise.sumo_deadlift.technique.0: Wide stance, toes out, hands inside knees; keep chest up and push floor apart as you stand.
exercise.sumo_deadlift.setup.0: Bar over mid-foot; shins vertical-ish; brace hard.
exercise.sumo_deadlift.breathing: Brace before pull; exhale at lockout.
exercise.tempo_run.technique.0: Sustained harder effort near threshold for a controlled block after warm-up; not an all-out race.
exercise.tempo_run.setup.0: Warm up thoroughly; cool down after.
exercise.tempo_run.breathing: Harder breathing but sustainable short phrases.
exercise.tempo_run.safety.0: Limit hard sessions; keep most volume easy (Seiler distribution evidence is descriptive).
exercise.three_legged_dog.technique.0: From downward dog, lift one leg high without rotating the hips open unless intended; switch.
exercise.three_legged_dog.setup.0: Strong hands; soft standing knee if needed.
exercise.three_legged_dog.safety.0: Keep pelvis relatively square for strength focus.
exercise.trap_bar_deadlift.technique.0: Stand inside the trap bar, hinge and grip handles, stand tall by pushing the floor away, then hinge back down.
exercise.trap_bar_deadlift.setup.0: High or low handles based on mobility; neutral spine.
exercise.trap_bar_deadlift.safety.0: Often friendlier for beginners than straight-bar pulls.
exercise.tree_pose.technique.0: Stand on one leg; place other foot on ankle/calf/inner thigh (not the knee); hands at heart or overhead.
exercise.tree_pose.common_mistakes.0: Pressing into the side of the knee joint
exercise.triangle_pose.technique.0: From wide stance, hinge and reach front hand to shin/block/floor; top arm stacks; long spine.
exercise.triangle_pose.setup.0: Use a block under the bottom hand.
exercise.triangle_pose.common_mistakes.0: Rounding to touch the floor at all costs
exercise.triangle_pose.contraindications: Discogenic pain with side bend — modify
exercise.tricep_pushdown.technique.0: Elbows fixed at sides; extend the elbows against a cable; return without flaring elbows.
exercise.tricep_pushdown.setup.0: Neutral ribs; light enough to feel triceps.
exercise.walking_lunge.technique.0: Step forward, descend until back knee nears floor, drive through front mid-foot into next step.
exercise.walking_lunge.setup.0: Tall torso; steps long enough for balance.
exercise.walking_lunge.common_mistakes.1: Short choppy steps with torso tipping
exercise.warrior_i.technique.0: Lunge with back foot angled, hips squared forward, arms reach up.
exercise.warrior_ii.technique.0: Wide stance; front knee bent; arms reach front-back at shoulder height; gaze over front hand.
exercise.warrior_ii.setup.0: Back foot parallel-ish to short edge of mat.
exercise.weighted_pull_up.technique.0: Perform strict pull-ups with added load via dip belt, weighted vest, or a dumbbell held between the feet/ankles.
exercise.weighted_pull_up.setup.0: Only after solid unassisted sets; secure belt/vest; soft-clamp dumbbell safely if used.
exercise.weighted_pull_up.breathing: Exhale on the pull; brace before heavier reps.
exercise.weighted_pull_up.safety.0: Prefer belt or vest for heavier loads; mind grip fatigue.
exercise.weighted_pull_up.contraindicati: Same as pull-up; avoid if unassisted form fails
exercise.wheel_pose.technique.0: From bridge preparation, press into hands by ears and lift into a full backbend if appropriate.
exercise.wheel_pose.safety.0: Advanced; skip if unsure — use bridge instead.
exercise.worlds_greatest_stretch.techniq: From a lunge, hand inside front foot; rotate and reach that arm up; optional hamstring straighten.
exercise.wrist_curl.technique.0: Forearms on thighs/bench; curl the load using the wrists; lower to stretch.
template.beginner_5k_8w.rationale: Mostly easy running with one quality stimulus reflects polarised descriptive distributions; weekly mileage increases softly with an honest caveat that fixed 10% rules are weakly evidenced.
template.bodyweight_travel_3x.rationale: Short full-body circuits maintain stimulus while travelling; pair with walking for energy expenditure per ACSM activity guidance.
template.concurrent_lift_run_4x.rational: Two lifting days plus two easy runs balance musculoskeletal and cardiorespiratory fitness per ACSM multi-component guidance; hard intervals limited.
template.desk_worker_mobility_strength.r: Combines posterior-chain and upper-back strength with thoracic/hip mobility to offset sedentary postures, within ACSM multi-component recommendations.
template.full_body_beginner_3x.rationale: Three full-body sessions spread weekly hard-set volume so major muscles are trained ~2–3×/week, matching frequency evidence when volume is accumulated and ACSM guidance for multi-joint work.
template.glute_posterior_emphasis.ration: Hinge and hip-extension emphasis raises glute/hamstring weekly sets within established hypertrophy volume bands; hip thrust included given EMG comparisons versus squats.
template.home_minimal_3x.rationale: Band + bodyweight full-body work preserves multi-joint stimulus when a gym is unavailable, aligned with ACSM guidance that some resistance is better than none.
template.hypertrophy_dumbbell_4x.rationa: Upper/lower with dumbbells targets ~10–16 weekly hard sets per region using double progression in 8–12 rep ranges.
template.older_adult_functional_3x.ratio: Sit-to-stand, carries, and supported patterns emphasise function and balance with conservative RIR, consistent with ACSM guidance for older adults' multi-component training.
template.pilates_core_3x.rationale: Controlled trunk endurance and motor control sessions complement ACSM neuromotor recommendations without high spinal load.
template.ppl_6x.rationale: PPL twice weekly delivers high frequency and volume for hypertrophy seekers who recover well; volume should still respect diminishing returns from Pelland et al.
template.strength_focus_3x.rationale: Novice linear progression on squat/hinge/press/pull compounds with conservative accessories, consistent with ACSM RT overview emphasis on multi-joint loading.
template.swim_technique_3x.rationale: Prioritise drill density before yardage so aerobic volume does not entrench poor mechanics; easy aerobic dominance still applies when conditioning.
template.upper_lower_4x.rationale: Four-day upper/lower keeps ~2× weekly frequency per muscle while allowing higher per-session volume within Schoenfeld/Pelland dose–response bands.
template.yoga_mobility_flow.rationale: Flexibility and neuromotor practice on ≥2–3 days/week aligns with ACSM quantity/quality guidance; poses stay beginner-accessible.

exercise.archer_pull_up.technique.0: Wide pronated grip; pull toward one hand while the opposite arm straightens (archer position).
exercise.archer_pull_up.technique.1: Alternate sides; keep the working shoulder packed.
exercise.archer_pull_up.setup.0: Only after consistent strict pull-ups; optional band under the straight-arm side.
Losing scapular control on the working side
exercise.archer_pull_up.safety.0: High shoulder demand — progress gradually; use bands.
exercise.assisted_pull_up_band.technique: Progress by using a thinner band over time.
exercise.band_assisted_dip.technique.0: Loop a band over parallel bars and kneel or place feet on it; perform dips with reduced net load.
exercise.band_assisted_dip.setup.0: Secure band; stable bars; control depth.
exercise.band_assisted_dip.safety.0: Still respect pain-free depth; inspect bands.
exercise.bench_dip.technique.0: Hands on a bench behind you, feet on the floor (or elevated for harder variants); bend elbows to lower, then extend.
exercise.bench_dip.technique.1: Keep hips close to the bench; use a modest ROM if shoulders complain.
exercise.bench_dip.setup.0: Stable bench; shoulders away from ears.
exercise.bench_dip.common_mistakes.0: Going too deep into shoulder extension
exercise.bench_dip.safety.0: Bench dips often use large shoulder extension — prefer shallow ROM or parallel-bar progressions if shoulders are irritable (McKenzie et al. 2020/2022).
exercise.chin_up.technique.1: Pull until the chin clears the bar, emphasising elbow flexion with the lats still driving the elbows down.
exercise.close_grip_pull_up.technique.0: Pronated or neutral grip with hands closer than shoulder-width.
exercise.close_grip_pull_up.technique.1: Pull with elbows tracking nearer the torso; clear the chin; lower fully.
exercise.close_grip_pull_up.setup.0: Avoid ultra-narrow grips that crank the wrists.
exercise.close_grip_pull_up.common_mista: Turning the set into a kip
exercise.close_grip_pull_up.safety.0: Watch wrist comfort; neutral close grips are a useful option.
exercise.commando_pull_up.technique.0: Stand side-on to the bar; grip with hands close, one palm facing each direction along the bar.
exercise.commando_pull_up.technique.1: Pull so the head passes to one side of the bar, then alternate sides each rep or set.
exercise.commando_pull_up.setup.0: Clear head path beside the bar; start from a controlled hang.
exercise.commando_pull_up.common_mistake: Hitting the face on the bar
exercise.commando_pull_up.safety.0: Advanced asymmetry — master standard pull-ups first; mind neck clearance.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.technique.1: Descend by bending the elbows until upper arms approach parallel to the floor (or a pain-free depth), then press to lockout.
exercise.dip_parallel_bar.safety.1: Use assistance before adding load; stop with anterior shoulder pain.
exercise.inverted_row.technique.1: Raise the feet or lower the bar to progress difficulty.
Acute low-back pain with bridging positions — bend knees
exercise.korean_dip.technique.0: From a straight-bar support facing away from the direction of lean used in standard straight-bar dips, perform controlled dips with high shoulder and wrist demand.
exercise.korean_dip.technique.1: Only attempt with established straight-bar support strength.
exercise.korean_dip.setup.0: Advanced gymnastics-style variation; spot or mat as appropriate.
exercise.korean_dip.safety.0: Very high shoulder-extension and wrist stress — prefer parallel-bar and ring progressions; omit if unsure.
exercise.korean_dip.safety.1: Limit depth; stop immediately with anterior shoulder pain (McKenzie et al. 2020).
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.technique.0: From a hang, raise straight legs to an L (hips ~90°) and hold that position while performing pull-ups.
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.technique.1: Keep the lumbar spine from excessively rounding or swinging.
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.setup.0: Needs solid hanging leg-raise control before loading pull-ups.
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.breathing: Exhale on the pull; do not breath-hold the entire L.
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.safety.0: Stop if hip-flexor cramping forces loss of shoulder position.
exercise.l_sit_pull_up.contraindications: Acute lumbar disc flare with hip flexion
Use an assisted dip/pull-up machine; select assistance; perform full controlled dips on the handles.
exercise.machine_assisted_dip.setup.0: Handles and pad adjusted; track assistance weight.
exercise.machine_assisted_dip.common_mis: Excess depth under high assistance that teaches poor positions
exercise.machine_assisted_dip.safety.0: Limit end-range extension; progress assistance down gradually.
exercise.machine_assisted_pull_up.techni: Select assistance on a counterbalance/assisted pull-up machine; kneel or stand on the pad; perform full-ROM pull-ups.
Reduce assistance as strength improves (track the assistance load).
exercise.machine_assisted_pull_up.common: Using so much assistance that scapulae never engage
exercise.machine_assisted_pull_up.safety: Keep knees/feet secure on the pad; controlled tempo.
exercise.negative_dip.technique.0: Start at the top support (jump or step), lower for 3–5+ seconds to a chosen depth, then step down to reset.
exercise.negative_dip.setup.0: Parallel bars preferred; define a pain-free bottom position before starting.
exercise.negative_dip.safety.0: Eccentrics are fatiguing; keep depth conservative for shoulders.
exercise.negative_pull_up.technique.0: Jump or step to the top chin-over-bar position, then lower for 3–5+ seconds to a full hang.
exercise.negative_pull_up.technique.1: Reset at the top each rep; do not bounce out of the bottom.
exercise.negative_pull_up.setup.0: Box or jump access to the top; choose pronated, neutral, or chin-up grip.
exercise.negative_pull_up.breathing: Inhale or brace through the slow descent; avoid panic breath-holds.
exercise.negative_pull_up.common_mistake: Dropping the last third of the ROM
exercise.negative_pull_up.safety.0: High eccentric fatigue — low volume; recover between sessions.
Pull the chest toward the handles until the chin clears; lower to a full hang.
exercise.neutral_grip_pull_up.setup.0: Neutral handles or parallel bars; shoulder-friendly for many athletes.
exercise.neutral_grip_pull_up.safety.0: Often more elbow-friendly than extreme pronation/supination — still stop with pain.
exercise.pull_up.technique.1: Depress and retract the scapulae, then pull elbows down and back until the chin clears the bar.
exercise.pull_up.technique.2: Lower under control to a full hang without dumping into the shoulder capsule.
exercise.pull_up.safety.1: Build volume with assistance before max efforts
exercise.ring_dip.progressions.weighted_: Load on rings or return to bars
exercise.scapular_pull_up.technique.0: From a passive hang, depress and slightly retract the scapulae to lift the body a few centimetres without bending the elbows, then return to a passive hang.
exercise.scapular_pull_up.setup.0: Pronated or neutral grip; think “pockets” for the scapulae.
exercise.scapular_pull_up.common_mistake: Bending the elbows into a mini pull-up
exercise.scapular_pull_up.safety.0: Excellent primer; stop with sharp shoulder pain in the hang.
exercise.straight_bar_dip.technique.0: Support on a single straight bar (as in a muscle-up support), lean the chest over the bar, dip by bending elbows, then press back to support.
exercise.straight_bar_dip.setup.0: Requires strong support hold; wrists stacked; bars at appropriate height.
exercise.straight_bar_dip.common_mistake: Losing the lean and peeling off the bar
exercise.straight_bar_dip.safety.0: High skill/shoulder demand — progress from parallel-bar dips.
exercise.typewriter_pull_up.technique.0: Pull to the top, then shift the chest laterally along the bar toward one hand while staying high, then to the other, then lower.
exercise.typewriter_pull_up.setup.0: Requires strong isometric top position; clear bar length.
exercise.typewriter_pull_up.breathing: Steady breathing at the top; exhale as you shift.
exercise.typewriter_pull_up.safety.0: Advanced — fatigue raises shoulder risk; low volume.
exercise.typewriter_pull_up.progressions: More eccentric on the straight arm
exercise.weighted_dip.technique.0: Perform parallel-bar (or ring) dips with a dip belt, vest, or carefully held dumbbell between the legs.
exercise.weighted_dip.technique.1: Keep depth in a pain-free range; load only with solid unassisted form.
exercise.weighted_dip.setup.0: Secure belt; prefer parallel bars before heavy ring loading.
exercise.weighted_dip.safety.0: Added load magnifies shoulder stress at end-range extension — prefer controlled depth (McKenzie et al. 2020).
Shoulder pain; inability to perform clean unassisted dips
exercise.wide_grip_pull_up.technique.0: Pronated grip clearly wider than shoulders (avoid extreme snatch-grip widths that irritate the shoulder).
exercise.wide_grip_pull_up.technique.1: Pull elbows down toward the sides until the chin clears; lower fully.
exercise.wide_grip_pull_up.setup.0: Mark a sustainable wide grip; do not chase maximal width.
exercise.wide_grip_pull_up.common_mistak: Excessively wide grip that forces painful shoulder positions
exercise.wide_grip_pull_up.safety.0: Wide grips can increase shoulder stress — stay within a comfortable scapular plane.
